messages.subject: Spam issue in Google Groups
parts:
Dear all,

I really apologize for my slow reply here, things are not helped by the considerable amount of spam I have to remove every time I look into the threads.

Should I move the support for Sequenza some other, maybe more engaging platforms, like a discord server?
Any suggestion is appreciated (if you still follow the group notifications, are you bothered by the spam at all, or is google actually muting those messages?)

Best regards

Francesco

messages.author: 74f7ca5071560de4
messages.subject: Re: Spam issue in Google Groups
parts:
For me I think the group should move out to a better engaging platform, those spammers will still find their way in here, I've seen that In many other Google groups, it's discouraging to engage into conversations here after seeing a lot of spam messages. It's just a matter of time before Google itself will ban this group for volition of terms and conditions. There's been a lot of spam in the past months and I think Google has registered all that already. It's better the group moves out 

Humble opinion.

Frank
